The '''MIT Sloan Sports Analytics Conference''' (SSAC) is an annual event that provides a forum for industry professionals (executives and leading researchers) and students to discuss the increasing role of [[analytics]] in the [[sport industry|sports industry]]. The conference is held in the [[Boston]] area, and while its location has moved from the [[Campus of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology|MIT campus]] to higher capacity convention centers such as the [[Hynes Convention Center]] and the [[Boston Convention and Exhibition Center]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Past Conferences with MIT Sloan Sports Analytics Conference |url=https://www.sloansportsconference.com/past-conferences |access-date=2024-08-22 |website=www.sloansportsconference.com}}</ref> it has always occurred during February or March. 

Founded in 2006, the conference is co-chaired by [[Daryl Morey]], who was most recently president of basketball operations for the [[Philadelphia 76ers]], and Jessica Gelman, CEO of [[Kraft Analytics Group]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://kagr.com/about/|title=About Kagr - Jessica Gelman - Partners - KAGR - Advanced analytics and Strategic Marketing|website=kagr.com|date=2 May 2016 |accessdate=8 April 2018}}</ref> who oversee [[MIT Sloan School of Management|MIT Sloan]] students (from the EMS Club){{#tag:ref|The MIT Sloan EMS Club is a student-run club that aims to help MIT Sloan students learn about its target industries as well as extend the MIT Sloan brand as a leading business school in the entertainment, media, and sports worlds.|group="nb"}} in the planning and operating of the yearly conference. It is the largest student-run conference in the world, attracting students from over 170 different schools and representatives from over 80 professional sports teams in [[Major League Baseball]], the [[National Basketball Association]], [[National Football League]], [[National Hockey League]], [[Major League Soccer]], and [[Premier League]].<ref>{{cite web|last=Fasulo |first=Nick |url=https://www.sbnation.com/2011/3/4/2030635/mit-sloan-sports-analytics-conference-malcolm-gladwell |title=MIT Sloan Sports Analytics Conference, Day 1: Explaining The 10,000 Hour Rule, And More |publisher=SBNation.com |date=2011-03-04 |accessdate=2013-03-04}}</ref> The conference has been sold out every year and has become the premier venue for [[sports analytics]] discussion. [[ESPN]] has been the presenting [[sponsor (commercial)|sponsor]] since 2010, and the conference has garnered national attention through media outlets such as ''[[Sports Illustrated]]'', ''[[The Wall Street Journal]]'', ''[[The New York Times]]'', ''[[The Boston Globe]]'', ''[[Time (magazine)|Time]]'', ''[[BusinessWeek]]'', [[NBC Sports]], [[Fox Sports (United States)|Fox Sports]], ''[[Pardon the Interruption]]'', and ''[[Forbes]]''. The conference was ranked by ''[[Fast Company (magazine)|Fast Company]]'' as the third-most innovative company in sports in 2012.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.fastcompany.com/most-innovative-companies/2012/industry/sports |title=The World's 50 Most Innovative Companies in Sports 2012 |publisher=Fast Company |date=2012-03-13 |accessdate=2013-03-04}}</ref>
